purpose: Verified input for a public TLA handover timeline. Research output only; this agent did not publish.
scope: The original ten TLA contracts named by the launch registry and transferred together on 2 September 2024. Phoenix Treasury is a separate related timeline, excluded from the strict 31-operation count.

public_launch_post.title: Launching Terra Liquidity Alliance
public_launch_post.admin_promise_exact: Contract Admin will be transferred to PD Stewardship after 1 month.
public_launch_post.owner_promise_exact: Ownership transferred to PD Stewardship after 3 months.
public_launch_post.start_clock: No explicit start-date formula accompanies these two promises.
public_launch_post.authority_context: The post identifies the two exact ERIS wallets and distinguishes code-migration administration, configuration ownership, and delegated board roles.
public_launch_post.provenance_limit: This is a repository-preserved forum copy with archived author/date metadata, not an independently authenticated contemporaneous forum revision log.

native_proposal_4817.title: Launching Terra Liquidity Alliance
native_proposal_4817.interpretation: The three messages create Alliance assets. They do not execute the promised administrator/owner handover. The record states passed; voting_end_time is not a separately recovered enactment-block timestamp.

september_2_transfer.effect: Moves migration administration of all ten original contracts to the second ERIS wallet. It does not change the registry owner.

deadline_analysis.precision_note: The older ledger truncates the proposal timestamp to whole seconds. No counted operation lies near that subsecond boundary.
deadline_analysis.classification: Analytical calendar-month convention, not an exact deadline printed in the promise.

deadline_analysis.robustness: Using the later 2 September administrator transfer as an alternative anchor moves the dates to 2 October and 2 December. The strict post-three-month total remains 31 operations in 19 transactions because its first entry is 18 December.
deadline_analysis.publication_wording: Using proposal 4817’s voting end as the clock gives 27 September for administration and 27 November for ownership. The promise does not specify the clock; even starting from the later 2 September transfer, all 31 counted operations occurred after the three-month period.

post_deadline_count.scope_limit: A verified minimum in the bounded indexes and methods reviewed, not a proof that every possible historical operation was found. Count operations, not thefts, losses or legal conclusions.

titles: Admitted ERIS arbLUNA to voting escrow
effects: Added another ERIS product as eligible voting-escrow deposit collateral and selected its ERIS arbitrage vault as exchange-rate source. This changes product eligibility and voting collateral; it is more than a software-version update.
Exercised the power to replace the gauge implementation. Exact old/new binaries are preserved; a complete source-level explanation has not been recovered.
Exercised migration authority over the contract administering voting incentives.
Installed code3585 on Stable, Project and Bluechip staking. Three contract changes in one transaction.

titles: Changed the authorized BOT operator list
effects: Added an operator to the list used by related automation. BOT is an execution permission; it is not the same as the power to set fees or replace code.

titles: Replaced voting-escrow code: first August upgrade
effects: Installed code3690 in the original voting-escrow contract.

titles: Replaced voting-escrow code a third time
effects: Replaced code3692 with3694 another hour later. Three separate exercises of the retained migration key.

Replaced Stewardship as FEE_COLLECTOR with the ERIS fee account. The separately reconciled captured stream is228payments /2,280LUNA, approximately$159.95 at receipt-time prices; not the wider ERIS fee total.

titles: Set the destination for excluded incentive rewards
effects: Set BURN_RECIPIENT to the PF operations wallet. The exact deployed code sends excluded rewards there; the name alone does not mean the underlying value is destroyed.

Upgraded the three original staking contracts to4033. The new interface permits the registry owner to exclude specified assets from incentive allocation and route their reward share to BURN_RECIPIENT. The same transaction also touched the later Single contract, outside this strict count.

titles: Excluded a Bluechip asset from incentives
effects: Called the new owner-only update_incentive_blacklist method for one CW20 asset. The ensuing reward-update transaction sent receipt tokens to the configured operations wallet.

Added asset lists to all three original staking contracts. The same transaction also covered the later Single contract. This changes reward allocation without using the ordinary asset-whitelist board role.

Removed the bulk asset lists from the three original contracts, about2hours42minutes after adding them. The ledger preserves the exact add/remove arrays rather than assuming every prior exclusion was cleared.
Installed code4037, which consults ASSET_STAKING_BLACKLIST. Controlled execution of the exact binary shows listed senders fail stake, unstake and reward-claim operations before account-state checks.

titles: Put Philipp’s project address in the new FIX list
effects: Set ASSET_STAKING_FIX to the project address. At this moment4037 still read the differently named BLACKLIST list, so this assignment alone did not yet activate the tested4038 restriction.

titles: Changed the restriction to read the FIX list
effects: Installed code4038, four minutes19seconds after4037. It reads ASSET_STAKING_FIX and applies the same sender-dependent failures. Both binaries report the samev1.9.10 label despite different hashes.

titles: Replaced the restricted address with another wallet
effects: Replaced the project address with terra1uaspcnh3r5etr3szfmgn6ecuum00dm3l7fstvz. That entry remained effective for15days12hours52minutes32seconds. This proves the restriction was configured; no failed live attempt by that wallet after activation has been recovered.

Emptied ASSET_STAKING_FIX on18October2026. This is another actual use of the retained owner key,690days after the common counting cutoff. Removing the entry did not transfer the owner or administrator to Stewardship.

october18_snapshot.admin_history_result: Each original contract-wide UpdateAdmin index returned the same single 2 September 2024 transfer. No later transfer to Stewardship was returned.
october18_snapshot.precision_limit: The registry ownership query and the ten-contract admin metadata snapshot are separate queries at different heights on 18 October; they are not represented as one atomic snapshot.

separate_treasury_timeline.title: Treasury deployed under the ERIS configuration wallet
separate_treasury_timeline.finding: The instantiate message explicitly names the ERIS configuration wallet as upgrade administrator and uses the pre-existing TLA registry.

separate_treasury_timeline.title: Stewardship assigned Treasury application roles
separate_treasury_timeline.finding: Registry set_addresses assigns PDT_CONTROLLER and PDT_CONFIG_OWNER to Stewardship. This is not a transfer of registry ownership or contract migration administration.

separate_treasury_timeline.title: Treasury funding vote begins
separate_treasury_timeline.finding: Proposal 4822 creates Alliance funding; its executable messages do not transfer the Treasury administrator.

separate_treasury_timeline.title: Treasury configuration role reassigned to ERIS
separate_treasury_timeline.finding: PDT_CONFIG_OWNER changes from Stewardship to the ERIS configuration wallet during proposal 4822 voting. The distinct PDT_CONTROLLER role is unchanged by this transaction.

separate_treasury_timeline.title: Treasury funding vote ends; proposal recorded passed
separate_treasury_timeline.finding: Proposal 4822 creates Alliance funding; its executable messages do not transfer the Treasury administrator.

separate_treasury_timeline.title: Treasury upgrade administration moved between ERIS wallets
separate_treasury_timeline.finding: This is MsgUpdateAdmin, not a code migration. It moved authority already created on 7 October 2024; it neither created the authority for the first time nor transferred it to Stewardship.

separate_treasury_limit: The Treasury uses the same registry but was deployed later, on 7 October 2024. The TLA launch post is not automatically a separate express Treasury handover deadline. The 23 September 2026 transaction is an administrator change, not a code migration or first creation of control.
interpretive_limits: The original post disclosed temporary ERIS control. The documented issue is retention after the promised period and later exercise, not that the initial arrangement was wholly unmentioned.
On-chain records establish addresses and authorization. They do not identify the person physically signing or prove exclusive human custody of either key.
No approved extension was located in the reviewed corpus; this is not proof that no off-chain approval document exists.
Giving Stewardship particular application roles is distinct from transferring registry ownership or upgrade administration.
No live mutations, outreach, publication or edits to other research outputs were performed.
